title: うさぎ (Usagi — Rabbit)
description: A traditional Japanese warabe-uta (children's folk chant) about a rabbit that sees the full moon on the fifteenth night and leaps toward it. The image of a rabbit on the moon comes from the Buddhist Jataka tale in which a selfless rabbit sacrificed itself and was placed on the moon by Indra. Japanese children still see the rabbit pounding mochi in the full moon's craters.
